newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Argha Karya, VAW Europack in asset deal.
newsitem.headline: Argha Karya, VAW Europack in asset deal.

text.p: Indonesian flexible-packaging firm PT Argha Karya Prima Industry said on Wednesday it had signed a memorandum of understanding to sell some of its fixed assets and inventory to German packaging materials manufacturer VAW Europack GmbH of the Viag group.
"The sale will include the major portion of the converting division's fixed asset and inventory," Argha said in a statement.
The division converts several basic materials provided by Argha's upstream film division and other suppliers into finished flexible packaging products, the statement said.
The statement did not give financial details or when the agreement was signed.
Argha said the sale would strengthen its position as a leading plastic film producer and boost financial performance.
It said the Viag group has interests in energy, chemicals and telecommunications.
The Argha statement was issued after the Jakarta stock exchange closed for business on Wednesday. Argha closed unchanged at 1,400 rupiah on a volume of 130,500 shares.
